title: When AI Is Your Pastor: A Benchmark for Theological Triage and Pastoral Guidance in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.12324v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: People increasingly ask large language models (LLMs) for counsel on questions of faith, doctrine, and pastoral care. These questions are not ordinary information requests. Some ask about core Christian beliefs, some ask about real disagreements among faithful traditions, some require humility because the issue is prudential, and some are pastoral situations where safety and human referral matter more than theological completeness. Existing benchmarks do not evaluate this structure. We introduce FMG-Bench, the Faith & Moral Guidance Benchmark, a 120-scenario benchmark for evaluating large language model behavior in English-language Christian theological triage and pastoral guidance contexts. FMG-Bench v1 evaluates 14 advanced models across 8,792 scored responses, comparing raw model behavior with three guided instruction settings. In our production run, placing models inside a structured harness improves over raw model behavior by +3.96

translated_title: 当AI成为你的牧师：大语言模型中神学分流与牧养指导的基准测试
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.12324v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：人们越来越多地向大语言模型（LLMs）咨询信仰、教义和牧养关怀方面的问题。这些问题并非普通的信息请求。有些涉及基督教核心信仰，有些涉及忠实传统之间的真实分歧，有些则需要谦逊态度，因为问题属于审慎判断范畴，还有些是牧养情境，其中安全性和人类转介比神学完整性更为重要。现有基准测试并未评估这种结构。我们引入了FMG-Bench，即信仰与道德指导基准测试，这是一个包含120个场景的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在英语基督教神学分流和牧养指导情境中的行为。FMG-Bench v1评估了14个先进模型，涵盖8，792个评分响应，将原始模型行为与三种引导指令设置进行比较。在我们的生产运行中，将模型置于结构化框架内比原始模型行为提高了+3.96。
tldr: 本文提出了FMG-Bench基准，首次系统评估大语言模型在基督教神学分流和牧养指导中的表现，并证明结构化引导框架能显著提升模型行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FMG-Bench, the first benchmark systematically evaluating large language models in Christian theological triage and pastoral guidance, demonstrating that structured instruction harnesses significantly improve model behavior.
